paite: Huan Asaph, Heman, Jeduthun tapa khenkhat kaihgingte, pekgingte, dakkhutbette toh ala vek a nasemmi ding in David leh sepaih heutute'n ahihtuam ua; nasep ding omdan bang zel in nasem mite tamdan ding asep uhi.
heading: Tempul A Lasa Mite
english: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

paite: Asaph tapate lak a mi Zakkur, Joseph, Nethaniah leh Asarelah ahi ua, amau bel Asaph tapate, kumpipa thupiak bang a zawlnei thugen a gen, Asaph thuthu a omte ahi uh.
english: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

paite: Jeduthun lak ah: Jeduthun tapate Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah leh Matithiahte, guk ahi uh; kaihging toh TOUPA kiang a kipahthu gen a la vek a apa uh Jeduthun thuthu a omte ahi uh.
english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising Yahweh with the harp.

paite: Heman lak ah: Heman tapate Bukkiah, Mataniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanni, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Malothi, Hothir leh Mahaziothte ahi uhi;
english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

paite: Huaite tengteng Pathian lam thu a kumpipa zawlnei Heman tapate pengkulkawi mut dingte ahi uh. Pathian in Heman tapa sawm-le-li leh tanu thum apia hi.
english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

paite: Huaite tengteng TOUPA' inn a dakkhutbet toh, kaihging toh, pekging toh, Pathian inn a nasepna ding a la toh lem mite, apa uh thuthu a omte ahi uh; Asaph, Jeduthun leh Hemante bel kumpipa thupiak iak a omte ahi leuleu uhi.
english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in Yahweh’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

paite: Atamlam uh, a-unau, TOUPA ding a lasak kisin siam khinsa tengtengte toh zanih sawmgiat-le-giat ahi uh.
english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to Yahweh, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

paite: Huan aneu leh alian, sinsakmi leh sinmi in atan ding uh kibang vek in ai asan uhi.
english: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

paite: Huchi in aisan akhatveina Asaph tapa Joseph tung ah atu a; anihveina Gedaliah tung ah; amah leh a-unaute leh atapate sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

paite: Athumveina bel Zakkur tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih ahi uh.
english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Aliveina Izri tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Angaveina Nethaniah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Agukveina Bukkiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asagihveina Jesharelah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Agiatveina bel Jeshaiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Akuaveina bel Mataniah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmveina Shimei tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-khatveina Azarel tung ah, atapa leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-nihveina Hashabiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-thumveina Shubael tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-liveina Matithiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-ngaveina Jeremoth tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-gukveina Hananiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-sagihveina Joshbekashah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-giatveina Hananiah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawm-le-kuaveina Malothi tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnihveina Eliathah tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnih-le-khatveina Hothir tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnih-le-nihveina Giddalti tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnih-le-thumveina Mahazioth tung ah, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih.
english: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

paite: Asawmnih-le-liveina Romamti-ezer tung ah atu a, atapate leh a-unaute sawm-le-nih ahi uhi.
english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.
